personal.name: Alex Vance
personal.title: Lead Cloud Solutions & AI Systems Engineer
personal.summary: Forward-thinking Cloud Architect and AI Systems Engineer with 8+ years of experience designing scalable serverless architectures, multi-region distributed backends, and automated cloud security defenses on AWS. Expert in microservices, IaC (CloudFormation/Terraform), and high-throughput real-time APIs.

experience.description: Architect of mission-critical serverless and event-driven architectures serving over 150M monthly active API requests across multi-region AWS deployments.
achievements: Migrated legacy monolithic endpoints to AWS Lambda and Amazon API Gateway, slashing operational compute costs by 48% while maintaining 99.99% availability.
Engineered zero-trust API security pipelines utilizing custom Lambda authorizers, API Gateway Usage Plans, and AWS WAF rate-based rules.
Implemented automated DynamoDB single-table design with Global Secondary Indexes, reducing P99 query latency from 180ms to 12ms.

experience.description: Led automated security orchestration, incident response runbooks, and serverless API gateway defense.
achievements: Developed automated EventBridge and Lambda incident response playbooks containing unauthorized S3 leaks and security group misconfigurations in under 3 seconds.
Designed and standardized CloudFormation and SAM templates across 45 AWS accounts adhering to CIS AWS Foundations Benchmarks.
Automated cryptographic verification and email security gateways implementing SPF, DKIM, and DMARC alignment.

experience.description: Built resilient RESTful microservices and data ingestion pipelines for real-time payments and credit scoring.
achievements: Implemented high-throughput REST APIs using API Gateway, Lambda, and DynamoDB processing $50M+ daily financial transactions.
Constructed automated CI/CD deployment pipelines using GitHub Actions and AWS CodePipeline with automated unit and integration tests.
